finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer has only 7 days from payment to request a refund unless a separate written deal says otherwise.

quote.text: Refund requests are handled under the Refund & Cancellation Policy and must be submitted within 7 days of the relevant payment unless a different written agreement applies.

finePrint.summary: Refund requests must be emailed within 7 days of payment with account and payment details.

quote.text: Refund requests must be sent to hello@screpy.com within 7 days of the payment.

finePrint.summary: A refund can be denied if the buyer heavily used paid resources before asking for it.

quote.text: Refunds may be denied for accounts that violate the Terms of Service, abuse trials or promotions, repeatedly request refunds, misuse the service, or use a plan in a way that materially consumes paid resources before requesting a refund.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can remove or limit features at any time, which could reduce what a lifetime deal includes.

quote.text: We may update, improve, remove, or limit features as the product evolves.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can suspend or limit access for activity it views as unauthorized, harmful, or inconsistent with terms.

quote.text: We may suspend or limit access if account activity appears unauthorized, harmful, or inconsistent with these terms.

finePrint.summary: Paid access normally lasts until end of billing period after cancel unless terminated for misuse or violation.

quote.text: After cancellation, paid features may remain available until the end of the current billing period unless the account is terminated for misuse or another policy violation.

finePrint.summary: Disputing a charge can lead to suspension while the vendor reviews the dispute.

quote.text: Chargebacks or payment disputes may result in account suspension while the dispute is reviewed.

finePrint.summary: The vendor does not promise uninterrupted or error-free service, so buyers cannot rely on guaranteed uptime.

quote.text: We work to keep the service available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

finePrint.summary: What you can do depends on your plan's websites, keywords, and reporting limits.

quote.text: Choose a plan based on your websites, tracked keywords, and reporting needs.

finePrint.summary: Features, capacity, and branding are capped by the active plan, not unlimited.

quote.text: Features, capacity, and branding depend on the active plan.

finePrint.summary: Report branding, widgets, and volume are limited by plan level.

quote.text: Branding, available widgets, and report volume depend on your plan.

finePrint.summary: Yearly plans are prepaid annually with a shown monthly equivalent, establishing the normal price baseline.

quote.text: Monthly subscriptions are billed each month. Yearly subscriptions are billed for the full year in one payment; the monthly price shown is the equivalent monthly cost.

finePrint.summary: The advertised 30% welcome discount stays only while the subscription remains active.

quote.text: Your welcome discount continues on every renewal while your subscription remains active.

finePrint.summary: A free trial automatically converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled before it ends.

quote.text: A trial subscription renews into a paid subscription unless you cancel before the trial ends.

exhibits.quote: I bought Screpy back in 2022 for uptime monitoring and it's quietly done its job for four years.

themes.summary: Several buyers say support stopped replying or never existed after purchase.

hits.quote: I asked for a refund as there is zero support
after 2 weeks, there has been no reply from Mr. Mustafa,
The chatbot claims to be a human, but no actual person ever responds, and I never got my question answered.
have only received automated responses — no meaningful human reply has been provided.
I sent a support request via email on the 7th of August to get information about some features and never got a reply.
On the 8th of July I sent an email about it, but unfortunately never got any response up until today 29th October 2024.
Keep waiting for their response to my email for over a week!

themes.summary: Many users report crawling failures, stuck analyses, and unreliable monitoring.

hits.quote: every attempt immediately returns a “Server Error”.
all my sites still saying 'Analyzing'. Not 1 single useable piece of information, even after almost a full day.
It frequently flags every page as broken, even when they’re fully operational.
every site I set up in Screpy is either stuck in "Analyzing" mode (one of these for more than 700 hours)
Screpy took a really long time to crawl the site.
It often gets stuck when updating SERP stats (keyword rankings), especially often it happens during weekends

themes.summary: Buyers say core LTD features now require extra payment or subscription.

hits.quote: Previously I used the competitors keywords and data, and now that needs a payment.
All of the other tools require either connection to Cloudflare (what is the point - I can log in there and see the same data) or an upgrade.
Keyword research is no longer available, back link function, and you can only access them now unless you subscribe.
Yet, you cannot access unless you pay 19 a month.

themes.summary: Long-term users say the tool reliably handles monitoring and audits.

hits.quote: What I love most about Screpy is its simplicity, ease-of-use, and its clean and easy to understand dashboard.
I bought the LTD early on and have been please with Screpy running in the background as reliable partner.
I bought Screpy back in 2022 for uptime monitoring and it's quietly done its job for four years.
